text:
mira: Quick poll: Pantry restock — I'm ordering snacks at 3pm. Vote with emoji: :chocolate_bar: = sweet, :pretzel: = savory, :green_salad: = healthy. Any allergies or GF requests, drop them here.
alex: :pretzel: savory for me. +1 for chips too.
devon: :green_salad: healthy please — also pls avoid nuts, thanks.
jamal: :chocolate_bar: I'd die for dark chocolate. Also can we get tea bags?
sophia: Love healthy but low-key crave :pretzel: today. If we get pretzels, can we get gluten-free option? :thinking_face:
mira: Noted on GF and nut allergy. Will order 2 savory, 1 sweet, 1 healthy if counts line up.
ops-bot: Reminder: office snack budget remaining this month: $42.50. Order must be <= $40 to avoid approval delay.
tanya: :pretzel: + :green_salad: split works. Also whole-grain crackers?
alex: If GF pretzels cost too much, happy to do regular pretzels and GF crackers as alt.
mira: Thanks! Tally so far: savory (alex, sophia, tanya) = 3, sweet (jamal) = 1, healthy (devon, tanya) = 2. I'll finalize at 3pm and ping receipt.
jamal: :thumbsup: 
devon: Also can we add a small note: 'no peanuts' on the order? allergic person in office.
mira: Yes — will add 'no peanuts' and include tea bag variety. Ordering now.
mira: Order placed: Pretzels (regular), GF crackers, Dark chocolate squares, Mixed salads, Assorted tea bags. Total $38.23. Invoice in #finance, tag @ops for expense.
ops-bot: Expense note: submitted to finance queue. ETA reimbursement 3-5 business days.
sophia: Yessss thank you! :raised_hands:
